observations: A solar panel with a white frame and a grid of dark cells.
A watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' is visible across the center of the panel.
The panel is leaning against a wall or a wooden structure.
The image contains a watermark 'CAMON 30' and '25mm 6/188 1/44a ISO900' at the bottom.
The panel appears to be in good physical condition with no obvious cracks or hot spots.

claims.evidence: The power rating is not visible in the photo.
The cell count is not visible in the photo.
No Canadian flag, logo, or import documentation is visible.
The panel is shown leaning against a wall, suggesting it is not in a showroom or new condition.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may not produce the claimed 600W output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may have micro-cracks or delamination not visible in a single photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cell surface and a video of the panel under sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may be a counterfeit or a different brand than the one claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or logo on the back of the panel.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing the voltage and current in sunlight.
Photo of the panel in a horizontal position to check for cracks or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
